captain_picard.observation: Strategic deployment successful. Dual-server architecture provides excellent separation of concerns. The dashboard (3001) and frontend (3000) coordination demonstrates proper command structure.
captain_picard.recommendation: Proceed with production hardening. Consider implementing authentication and role-based access control for the dashboard.

commander_data.observation: Technical architecture validated. N8N integration confirmed with 32 workflows (30 active). API response times optimal at <100ms for local operations. WebSocket implementation functioning correctly.
commander_data.recommendation: Database persistence layer required for production deployment. Current in-memory storage acceptable for development but not scalable.

geordi_laforge.observation: Infrastructure performing well. Both servers stable with low memory footprint (~15MB each). WebSocket server handling real-time updates efficiently.
geordi_laforge.recommendation: Add monitoring and alerting. Implement health check endpoints. Consider containerization for deployment consistency.

lieutenant_worf.observation: Security posture: MODERATE. API endpoints exposed without authentication. N8N API key present in environment but servers lack access control.
lieutenant_worf.recommendation: CRITICAL: Implement authentication immediately for production. Add API rate limiting. Secure WebSocket connections with authentication tokens.

counselor_troi.observation: User experience architecture looks promising. Dual-interface design (dashboard + frontend) provides flexibility for different user personas. Real-time updates enhance engagement.
counselor_troi.recommendation: Need to validate actual UI/UX with user testing. Dashboard interfaces opened but not manually tested in this session.

dr_crusher.observation: System health monitoring functional. Status endpoints returning comprehensive data. Server processes stable and running without errors.
dr_crusher.recommendation: Add detailed health metrics: CPU usage, request counts, error rates. Implement logging for debugging and audit trails.

lieutenant_uhura.observation: Communication architecture excellent. RESTful API design clean and consistent. WebSocket integration provides bidirectional real-time communication.
lieutenant_uhura.recommendation: Document all API endpoints thoroughly. Create OpenAPI/Swagger specification for developer onboarding.

quark.observation: Resource efficiency good. Minimal dependencies, native Node.js http server keeps costs low. No expensive third-party services required for core functionality.
quark.recommendation: Consider monetization strategy. Premium features could include advanced analytics, team collaboration, enterprise integrations.

verified_claims: N8N connection live (32 workflows via API)
acknowledged_limitations: Mock crew data (not from N8N yet)
